calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-14-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Two Minors.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Kathy Kollehner.
Venus Viloria, Esq. for Petitioners: Marisa L. Ignacio and Levy Ignacio, present as Guardian ad litem for the Two Minors: Kim Clifford Lacap and Ma. Agatha Cheyenn Lacap.
Petitioners were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Two Minors to: Kim Clifford L. Ignacio and Ma. Agatha Cheyenn L. Ignacio.
Decree signed in open court.
